card.name: Comma inside thousands-separated numbers
card.fires_on: The comma that separates thousands in a number, right after a short leading figure like 10, 20, 100 or 60, where zeros are expected next. It is seen in general prose with counts, years, distances and rates.

modes.label: Comma after round number
modes.description: Comma after 10, 100, 20 or 60 that starts a figure like 10,000 or 100,000.

modes.label: Comma in a list or range
modes.description: Comma after a number in a spoken-style range, where the next number follows.
modes.example: It really amps up the flavor of the glutamates 20<<,>> 30, even perhaps 4

card.writes: It promotes zero characters and suppresses unrelated pieces, so the model expects zeros after the comma.
card.plain: It spots the comma in a number like 10,000 and prepares the model to write the zeros that follow.
